GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok going forward Soon After settled Two Wide third had cover 2 Lengths (700m), brought to the Outside to challenge Straight , on terms 120, outgunned by the winner # sound/had chance
Jumped ok settled down Two Wide fourth 5 Lengths off the leading pair to duelled up front (700m), cornered 3rd, making Ground 200, with winner 120 couldn't match # sound/had chance

No rush off the Wide gate settled last 6 Lengths off the lead (700m), circling Wide out before Turn , 6 deep cornering Going Well though, chasing hard hit lead 100 & came away (Synthetic Hoof Filler OFF FIRST TIME) # last/wide/good!

Went Straight back from the Wide gate settled down last couple 9 Lengths (700m), Wide & on the move Soon After cornered for home widest 5 Lengths to make up, kept coming well just outgunned late (galloped on) # back/wide/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. A post-race vet exam revealed a laceration to the right foreleg consistent with being galloped on. Vet clearance prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat 6l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
Jumped Fair sat back 4l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 3l off held up, clear passing 200m, hit line well late # has excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Held up for clear running from the 400m until the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Went Forward Settled Down 3rd Outside 3 Lengths off leader/winner within 1 Lengths Turning for home Ridden Along flat @ 300m, # Effort Short Lived
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled on pace. Bumped on jumping. Rdr reported the mare was one-paced in the straight and may appreciate being ridden more conservatively. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex ron quinton) (synthetic hoof filler & Tongue Tie first time) was a Bit Slow Out . Settled Down Off Mid-Field (8th?) Just 4 Lengths @ 550m. fanned Wide to Best Going Straightening Up . had nowhere to go until over heels near 200m, attacked line final 100 when Clear . almost certainly Should Have Won . winner led # looked unlucky!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin & then was steadied when crowded. When qst, rdr std intended on leading, but after being slow to begin & suffering interference, mnt was obliged to settle worse than midfield. Std mnt was held up for clear running in early part of straight & near 300m was reluctant to improve into a narrow run, & as a result remained held up. Added near the 200m he shifted outwards to obtain clear running where he was able to apply some pressure to mnt, but at the 100m shifted inwards to continue into clear running, whereby it finished its race off strongly.
